parameters.name: multiOmicDataSet file pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression pattern to match a multiOmicDataset RDS file in data/

parameters.name: Contrast column name
parameters.description: Column in the metadata that contains the group variables you wish to find differential expression between

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of contrasts in format group1-group2 (e.g., treated-control,placebo-control)
parameters.help_text: This parameter is required. Specify each contrast in format group1-group2

parameters.name: Covariate columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of columns containing variables of interest to adjust for (e.g., phenotype, batch)
parameters.help_text: Most commonly this will be the same column selected for your Contrast Variable

parameters.name: Return mean and SD
parameters.description: If TRUE, return Mean and Standard Deviation of groups in addition to DEG estimates

parameters.name: Count type
parameters.description: Type of counts to use for differential expression. Must be a count type in names(moo@counts)

parameters.name: Sub count type
parameters.description: If count_type is a list, specify the sub count type within the list (e.g., voom, rlog)
parameters.help_text: Leave blank if count_type is not a list

parameters.name: Sample ID column name
parameters.description: Column from the sample metadata containing sample names
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to use the first column in the sample metadata by default

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: Column from the counts data containing Feature IDs
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to use the first column in the counts matrix by default

parameters.name: Samples to include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of samples to include in the analysis
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to include all samples

parameters.name: Input in log counts
parameters.description: If TRUE, counts are already log2-transformed

parameters.name: Voom normalization method
parameters.description: Normalization method for limma::voom. Options: quantile, TMM, TMMwzp, RLE, upperquartile
